items.title: A $300,000 Portfolio in Kimco Realty, Eversource and Nike Pays $13,643 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $300,000 portfolio split evenly across Kimco Realty, Eversource Energy and Nike pays about $1,140 a month in dividends at today’s prices. Eversource’s dividend is the best covered of the three, at 63% of normalized EPS in fiscal 2025, and Kimco paid out 80% of its AFFO that year.

A $1,200,000 Portfolio in Clorox, Kimco Realty and Eversource Pays $54,576 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,200,000 portfolio split evenly across Clorox, Kimco Realty and Eversource Energy pays $54,576 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $4,550 a month. Clorox’s dividend is the least covered of the three, at 133% of free cash flow over the last 12 months, and analysts expect that to fall to 74% next fiscal year.
